data.name: Fiorenza
data.gender_notes: Fiorenza is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Latin word 'flos', meaning flower, and 'renatus', meaning reborn. The name Fiorenza signifies a woman who is blooming with new life and flourishing in her faith. The name Fiorenza carries the meaning “Flourishing, Blooming” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Fiorenza usually hope their child will grow to embody flourishing, blooming and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of renewal and spiritual growth, inspired by the beauty and resilience of the flower.
data.etymology: Fiorenza belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Flourishing, Blooming.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fiorenza total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_greek.name: Φιορέντζα
in_greek.meaning: Άνθηση, ανάπτυξη, ευημερία σε χριστιανικό πλαίσιο
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Φιορέντζα προέρχεται από την ιταλική λέξη 'Fiorenza', που σημαίνει 'άνθηση' ή 'ανάπτυξη'. Η ετυμολογία του ονόματος συνδέεται με τη λατινική λέξη 'florens', που σημαίνει 'άνθησης' ή 'ευημερία'. Σε χριστιανικό πλαίσιο, το όνομα συμβολίζει την πνευματική ανάπτυξη και την άνθηση της πίστης.
